The '''battle baton''' was a simple energy weapon in the shape of a ribbed [[Scepter/Legends|scepter]]. They were wielded as a status symbol by [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]]. One such weapon was wielded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] during the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Second Battle of Mon Calamari]].

==History==
Mon Calamari battle baton was a simple energy weapon in the shape of a ribbed [[Scepter/Legends|scepter]]. They were wielded as a status symbol by [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Second Battle of Mon Calamari]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] used a Mon Calamari battle baton while leading the [[Mon Calamari Guard/Legends|Mon Calamari Guard]]. He used the weapon as both a baton and a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] as he led the Guard and protected [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]].<ref name="Water War" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The baton that Ackbar holds in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episodes "[[Water War]]" and "[[Prisoners]]" is an homage to his [[1983]] action figure that came with such an accessory. Though it was not originally intended to be a weapon, the episodic director [[Danny Keller]] vividly remembered pretending it was a blaster, so it was worked into the show.<ref name="Prisoners Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/prisoners-trivia|text="Prisoners" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 1}}</ref>
